source.description: A towering red demon lord with ram horns and folded bat wings, resting a massive flaming greatsword point-down, breathing slowly, embers rising, the sword's flames flickering steadily. Seamless loop.

The towering demon lord with ram horns attacks — he hoists the massive flaming greatsword overhead with both hands, then cleaves it down toward the camera in a fiery eruption, then plants it back point-down.

_notes: v3 humanoid character (boss), south direction only. Base sprite approved pre-session; idle+attack generated via v3, self-reviewed (gate 3 pre-approved).
